en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a scenic view over a city with a four‑towered Romanesque cathedral in the background. In the foreground, on a terrace framed by flowering tree branches, there are decorative stone balustrades covered with abundant fruit: a pile of large round fruits (likely peaches) on a tray atop a patterned cloth, and bunches of grapes arranged on a stone ornament. The reverse side is printed in multiple languages, identifying the cathedral in Pécs and laid out in the typical divided‑back postcard format.
